SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mms_work_order wo
wo.del_flag = '0' AND wo.actual_start IS NOT NULL AND wo.resource_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{resourceName}, '%') AND wo.work_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workOrderNo}, '%') AND DATE(wo.actual_start) >= #{params.beginTime} AND DATE(wo.actual_start) <= #{params.endTime}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NULL AS snapshot_id, COALESCE(rpt.stat_date, DATE(wo.actual_start)) AS snapshot_date, wo.resource_id, wo.resource_name, wo.work_order_id, wo.work_order_no, 0 AS planned_hours, 0 AS run_hours, 0 AS downtime_hours, 0 AS availability, 0 AS performance, 0 AS quality_rate, 0 AS oee, wo.qualified_qty AS good_qty, wo.defect_qty AS defect_qty, wo.create_time FROM mms_work_order wo LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.work_order_id, MAX(DATE(r.report_time)) AS stat_date FROM mms_work_report r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY r.work_order_id ) rpt ON rpt.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id WHERE wo.del_flag = '0' AND wo.actual_start IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.work_order_id = #{snapshotId}
